slides.title: Gemini will design with your brand kit
slides.sub: Google's new small business tools let you upload your fonts, colors and website once. Here's what that means if your brand isn't ready.

slides.title: Upload your brand once
slides.body: Businesses can upload their website, brand kit, fonts or color palettes. Gemini keeps that style, so you don't re-upload it for every request.

slides.title: Then it makes the visuals
slides.body: Using Google's Nano Banana 2.1 image model, Gemini creates product launch and campaign images that follow your saved brand guidelines.

slides.title: It connects to your tools
slides.body: Google Business Profile, Google Ads and Workspace, plus Adobe, Canva, Dropbox, Shopify, Wix, Zoho and Xero, all from one business page.

slides.title: Rolling out in coming days
slides.body: Google says the business page, marketing and finance tools and app connections are rolling out globally to Gemini app users.

slides.title: AI copies what you give it
slides.body: A brand kit with no clear logo, colors or fonts gives Gemini nothing to follow. It will make more of the same mixed look, just faster.

slides.title: Give Gemini a brand kit worth copying.
slides.body: We build logos, color systems, type and full brand guidelines for Black-owned businesses, ready to drop into any tool. DM us KIT to start the conversation.

caption:
Gemini brand kit checklist: 4 things Black-owned businesses should have ready before using Google's new small business tools.

Google has announced new tools in the Gemini app for small business owners. You can upload your website, brand kit, fonts or color palettes once, and Gemini keeps that style. It then uses Google's Nano Banana 2.1 image model to create product launch and campaign visuals that follow your guidelines. A new business page connects Google Business Profile, Google Ads and Workspace, plus Adobe, Canva, Dropbox, Shopify, Wix, Zoho and Xero. Google says it is rolling out globally to Gemini app users in the coming days.

Here's what to have ready first:
1. A logo file that works on light and dark backgrounds.
2. Your exact brand colors written down as codes.
3. One or two fonts you use every single time.
4. A website that shows your brand the way you want it copied.

AI copies what you give it. Give it a brand worth copying.

At Blackwell Graphics we build logos, color systems, type and full brand guidelines for Black-owned businesses. DM us "KIT" to talk it through, or visit blackwellgraphics.com (link in bio).
